text: hey nice [Image #5] thanks so uh  hm i just found a real ugly lookin bug. so i duplicated the heroin_bob_head and when t rying to rename it, it seems to have made 3 copies of it ? [Image #6] lol
resolution: Root-caused the 'duplicate then rename made 3 copies' report with req_3246: disk was never wrong (exactly ONE he_ad package dir, carrying all 15 recovered parts) — the extra rows were reconciler ghosts in the Assets tree. Cause: duplicate+rename stresses the array-sibling hazard — the name-sorted Models rows re-rank through a keyed sibling list on every rename keystroke while renameModel also moved the entire package directory per keystroke. Fixed in ab03a73a5: child lists get their own HW_TreeChildren container, the tree holds shape during an active rename, and the folder move settles once at finishRenameModel.
